stances.summary: Pandemic risk from Andes strain hantavirus is very low
stances.quote:
Hot off the press. A well referenced high quality statement from the International Hantavirus Society. 

High level:
- Andes strain is different
- some spread will occur
- pandemic potential is tremendously low
- lots to learn
- what happens next is up to us
